name: chronos
description: Schedule Claude Code tasks from Markdown plan files.

chronos.claudePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` executable. Leave as `claude` to resolve from PATH.

chronos.opencodePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `opencode` executable, used by tasks whose **Engine** is set to opencode. Leave as `opencode` to resolve from PATH. If it does not answer `--version` on startup, opencode is simply not offered as an engine — it is not an error. opencode keeps its own provider logins; run `opencode providers login` to reach anything beyond its free hosted models.

chronos.libraryPath.markdownDescription: Overrides where plans are kept. Leave empty for the default, `.chronos/plans` inside the folder you are working in — which is what makes each project's plans its own. Set here in *user* settings it points every project at one shared library again; set in *workspace* settings it moves just this project's. Changing it does not move existing plans, and already-scheduled tasks keep working either way, since they store absolute paths.

chronos.resultsPath.markdownDescription: Overrides where run transcripts are written — one subfolder per plan, one Markdown file per run. Leave empty for the default, `.chronos/results` inside the folder you are working in. These are never deleted automatically, unlike raw logs.

chronos.planModel.markdownDescription: Model used when generating a plan from a task in the **Tasks** view. Chosen from a dropdown each time you press **Generate plan**; this remembers your last choice. It does not affect scheduled runs, which use each plan's own model.

chronos.showTerminalOnRun.description: Reveal the terminal panel when a task starts. Focus is left where it is. Turn off if scheduled runs interrupt you.

chronos.maxConcurrent.description: Maximum number of tasks running at once. Raise deliberately: parallel agents editing one repository will collide.

chronos.maxRetries.description: Retry attempts after a failed run before the task is given up on.

chronos.retryDelayMinutes.description: Delay before retrying a failed run.

chronos.graceWindowMinutes.description: How late a task may fire and still run. Beyond this it is marked missed and waits for your decision instead of running unattended.

chronos.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Kill a run that produces no output for this long.

chronos.maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Hard wall-clock ceiling on a single run.

chronos.logRetentionDays.markdownDescription: Delete raw run logs older than this on startup. This does not touch the Markdown transcripts in `chronos.resultsPath`, which are kept indefinitely.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package
